newsitem.title: USA: AIG offers integrated market risk program.
newsitem.headline: AIG offers integrated market risk program.

text.p: American International Group Inc said its AIG Risk Finance division introduced an insurance program to integrate financial market risks.

The program called Commodity-Embedded Insurance (COIN) integrates foreign exchange, primary commodities or interest rate exposures within a multicoverage insurance program by using the expertise of AIG subsidiary AIG Trading Group Inc.
COIN programs will provide aggregate stop-loss coverage across both financial market and traditionally insured exposures, AIG said.
Insurance buyers may also realize tax and accounting benefits resulting from the integration of the financial market risks within their insurance program, AIG said.

"By integrating financial market exposures with insurable risks in a multiline program, COIN will offer clients a structure to smooth out earnings volatility and more effectively manage their total cost of risk," AIG Risk Finance president Tobey J. Russ said.
